title: Java Backend Developer (E-Commerce)

BİM's core principle is delivering essential food and consumer goods to customers at the highest quality and most competitive prices. title: Sr. Backend Engineer
description: Apilex is an AI-native legal operating system that manages lawyers' entire legal workflows end to end, powered by AI systems purpose-built for each jurisdiction's legal framework. We bring legal research, drafting of pleadings and contracts, document analysis, and case preparation together in a single experience. We currently operate in France, Turkey, and Germany, and we aim to extend the growth we've achieved in our current markets to Brazil, Spain, and Italy. We achieved this growth entirely bootstrapped, without raising any external investment, making us one of the fastest go-to-market success stories among Legal AI startups in the world. Since our founding, we've scaled our team to 120+ people, backed by a proprietary database of millions of court decisions and legal documents that turns days of legal research into seconds. What sets us apart? We don't use off-the-shelf AI. We build domain-specific, closed-circuit AI models with multi-layered verification systems that eliminate hallucinations and deliver answers backed by real citations and legal reasoning. Every feature we ship changes how lawyers work. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and scale the high-traffic microservices that form the backbone of our global legal AI platform. Key Responsibilities Scalable Architecture: Design and develop high-traffic, scalable microservice architectures to support our expanding global footprint. Code Excellence: Raise the bar on code quality by leading code review processes and implementing best practices across the backend. Technical Leadership: Provide mentorship to the engineering team and guide technical decision-making for complex features. System Integration: Build and maintain reliable integrations between core services, AI agents, and large-scale data stores. Performance Optimization: Ensure system reliability and low latency across distributed services through efficient caching and messaging strategies. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of backend experience building and scaling Java and Spring Boot applications in production Strong foundation in software architecture design including OOP and SOLID principles across various scales Hands-on experience with both PostgreSQL and MongoDB including the ability to design hybrid data architectures Deep knowledge of Elasticsearch or similar technologies for high-performance search and indexing Practical experience with messaging systems like RabbitMQ or Kafka and in-memory caching with Redis Solid understanding of WebSocket and real-time streaming architectures for distributed environments Direct experience with cloud platforms and building automated CI/CD pipelines Ability to ship high-quality code and iterate quickly rather than waiting for perfect conditions Why join us? Whatever your role, your work here will be visible and meaningful. We're a team that has grown without outside investment and achieved one of the fastest go-to-market successes in the space and we're looking for ambitious people who want to build the future of legal technology on a global stage. This is Apilex. AI for Legal. Join us.

title: AI - Native Full Stack Developer
description: AI-Native Full Stack Developer At Panteon, we are looking for Full Stack Developer teammates who strive for continuous self-improvement, radiate high energy, and have truly integrated AI tools into their production workflow. What We Expect? Enthusiasm for developing a high-traffic Business Intelligence (BI) tool that manages data across multiple applications. Full contribution to the creative process. An entrepreneurial mindset, high energy, motivation, and a strong sense of ownership. Being an excellent team player. Ability to work fast and efficiently. At least 3 years of professional work experience in this field. Ability to find fast and effective solutions to challenging problems. Proficiency in JavaScript. Knowledge and experience in NodeJS and React. Experience with database systems such as PostgreSQL, Redis, etc. Knowledge and experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or similar cloud services. Advanced level of English. Daily production experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) — we are looking for genuine usage habits, not just familiarity with the names. Ability to critically review AI output — never merging code without understanding it and questioning why a specific suggestion was made. Making your thought process visible while working with AI; ability to explain the reasoning behind decisions. Clarity and context management in prompt engineering; knowing how to ask the right questions the right way. What Will You Do? Work as part of our team in collaboration with Marketing and Game Design teams. Take part in the development process of a high-traffic BI tool. Ensure requirements are implemented effectively. Write error-free and sustainable code. Actively use AI tools in your daily development process — how you use them, when you use them, and what you choose to do yourself is important to us. Take responsibility for the quality and accuracy of the generated code; AI is the tool, you are the engineer. Work hard, learn a lot, and have plenty of fun with the team. What Will You Learn? Develop your skills by working on a scalable server architecture capable of handling high user volumes. Learn to process Big Data with high performance. Gain experience by tackling challenging problems. Master team collaboration, collective action, and knowledge sharing. Understand how AI tools are used within a real product team — which decisions are made by AI and where human judgment is mandatory. Practice making secure, sustainable changes in large codebases using AI and understanding its limitations. What We Offer? A comprehensive meal card covering all your food expenses. Private health insurance package. Subscriptions for Netflix, YouTube, Spotify, or Exxen. Fun company events and organizations. A strong team and work culture. The experience of working at one of the most established firms in the industry. If you want to be a part of our team, you can send us your CV.

Provide technical feedback to cross-functional stakeholders. Continuously assist in planning and provide updates on the progress of development work. Mentor and assist others in the team.
